Site Announcements

Early Voting - General Election

Early voting is open and continues until Friday, October 30, for the upcoming November 3 General & Special Election. Click here for early voting locations and times. For complete election information, click here.

× Close announcement for Early Voting - General Election
Commitment to Voter Security
Fulton County is committed to ensuring every voter can vote safely, privately, and without interference. We will continue to follow all applicable federal and state laws and protect the integrity and security of the voting process. Voters can be confident that every eligible vote cast in Fulton County will be handled with care. For factual information about election-related topics, please visit Election Facts and/or email elections.fulton@fultoncountyga.gov with any questions or concerns.

Voting and elections Early voting locationS

Upcoming Elections: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 - General Election
  • Fulton Home
  • Inside Fulton County
  • Fulton County Departments
  • Early Voting Locations

Fulton County encourages all voters to visit the Secretary of State's My Voter Page to review their voter registration information and sample ballot before voting. Confirming your information ahead of time ensures accuracy and helps streamline your experience at the polls. If you notice any discrepancies, please reach out to Fulton County Voter Registration for support. Our office is dedicated to verifying your information so you can proceed seamlessly to cast your ballot.

Advance Voting Hours and Locations

During the Advance Voting period, Fulton County voters may cast their ballots at any Fulton County Advance Voting location listed below. To find the most convenient location, please visit the Advance Voting Location Map.

Important Election Day Reminder: On Election Day, voters MUST cast their ballots at their assigned Election Day polling location. To confirm your assigned polling location, please visit the Georgia Secretary of State’s My Voter Page.

Attention Voters: Returning absentee-by-mail ballots at Fulton County Advance Voting locations without a designated absentee ballot drop box or Registrar’s Office has been discontinued. Voters may still conveniently return absentee-by-mail ballots by postal mail, at a Fulton County Registrar’s Office, or at one of seven Advance Voting locations with a designated absentee ballot drop box. Please note, absentee-by-mail ballots cannot be returned at your Election Day polling location. Visit Request/Return an Absentee Ballot for additional information.
